name: sales-skill
description: Convert qualified demand into committed customers — deals, pipeline, forecasts

interface.shortDescription: Convert qualified demand into committed customers — deals, pipeline, forecasts
interface.longDescription: The assisted buying process with the epistemics attached: whether a sales motion applies at all, ICP and qualification (frameworks kept distinct from selling methods), cold outbound with an AI-disclosure policy, discovery calls, demos, objections and battlecards, proposals and pricing presentation, CRM structure and deal pipeline with real exit criteria, forecasting honesty, and win/loss learning that treats a buyer's stated reason as testimony rather than data. The flagship answers what a pipeline number can honestly predict — and what to run instead at n=1.
defaultPrompt: Use $sales to build a bookings forecast from my open pipeline and tell me what it can honestly support.
